name.description: Kebab-case or single name segment (e.g. cliente, order-item). Creates src/app/<name>/ with Flow + Agent + demo page.

project.description: Angular application project name (default: first application in angular.json).

path.description: URL segment for lazy route (default: plural of name: cliente → clientes).

skipOmegaSetup.description: Do not merge imports/flows/agents in omega-setup.ts.
